foodie.title: Dim Sum in Chinatown at Dumplings' Legend
foodie.description: Watch the glass-walled kitchen fold xiao long bao by hand, then eat them ten minutes later.
foodie.bonus: Order one dish nobody at the table recognises.

foodie.title: Coffee Flight at Monmouth Borough
foodie.description: Taste three single-origin filters side by side at the counter that taught London what coffee could be.
foodie.bonus: Drink it black before you add anything.

foodie.title: Sunday Roast at The Guinea Grill
foodie.description: Settle into a Mayfair pub dining room for beef, a yorkshire the size of your face and gravy worth the walk.
foodie.bonus: Order the thing you can't pronounce on the menu.

foodie.title: Salt Beef Bagel at Beigel Bake
foodie.description: Join the 3am queue on Brick Lane for hot salt beef and mustard handed over a counter that has never once closed.
foodie.bonus: Order it with extra mustard and don't flinch.

foodie.title: Natural Wine Flight at Sager + Wilde
foodie.description: Work through a flight of cloudy, funky, low-intervention bottles under a railway arch in Bethnal Green.
foodie.bonus: Let the bartender pick all three glasses.

foodie.title: Cheese Tasting at Neal's Yard Dairy
foodie.description: Let the counter staff cut slivers of British farmhouse cheese until you find the one you'll be thinking about all week.
foodie.bonus: Buy the one you liked least on first taste.

foodie.title: Tasting Menu at Lyle's
foodie.description: Sit in a stripped-back Shoreditch room and eat a no-choice British menu that changes with whatever arrived that morning.
foodie.bonus: Ask the server what they'd eat and order exactly that.

foodie.title: Fish and Chips at Poppies Spitalfields
foodie.description: Eat proper battered cod in a 1950s chippy with rock and roll on the speakers and vinegar on the table.
foodie.bonus: Get the mushy peas even if you think you hate them.

foodie.title: Bacon Naan Breakfast at Dishoom
foodie.description: Start the day with a flaky bacon naan roll and a spiced chai at Dishoom's buzzing Covent Garden branch.
foodie.bonus: Order the bacon naan roll and a chai — no menu-scrolling allowed.

foodie.title: Sunday Browse at Maltby Street Market
foodie.description: Wander under the railway arches of Maltby Street for natural wine, salt beef, and vinyl crate-digging.
foodie.bonus: Buy a coffee from the smallest stall you can find.

foodie.title: Saturday Food Crawl at Borough Market
foodie.description: Graze your way through cheesemongers, doughnut stalls, and oyster shuckers at London's oldest food market.
foodie.bonus: Try a food stall you've never heard of before.

foodie.title: Afternoon Tea in Sketch's Gallery
foodie.description: Sip champagne and nibble patisserie in Sketch's Gallery, one of the most photographed dining rooms in London.
foodie.bonus: Take zero photos of the room — just be in it.

chill.title: Sunset from Primrose Hill
chill.description: Walk up the grassy slope for the postcard view of the whole skyline going orange behind Regent's Park.
chill.bonus: Bring something to share with whoever you came with.

chill.title: Deckchair Afternoon in St James's Park
chill.description: Rent a striped deckchair, point it at the lake and watch pelicans bully the ducks with Buckingham Palace behind you.
chill.bonus: Stay until you've done nothing for a full hour.

chill.title: Spa Afternoon at Porchester Spa
chill.description: Sweat through the Russian steam room and Turkish hot rooms of a 1929 art deco bathhouse in Bayswater.
chill.bonus: Do the cold plunge properly. All the way in.

chill.title: Glasshouse Morning at Kew Gardens
chill.description: Step from a London winter into the wet heat of the Palm House and stand among 200-year-old tropical trees.
chill.bonus: Find the oldest pot plant in the world — it's in there.

chill.title: Thames Clipper to Greenwich
chill.description: Take the fast boat downriver past Tower Bridge and Canary Wharf for the price of a tube fare.
chill.bonus: Sit outside on the back deck the whole way.

chill.title: An Hour in the Barbican Conservatory
chill.description: Find the hidden jungle bolted onto a brutalist concrete estate, full of fish ponds and hanging vines.
chill.bonus: Sit somewhere you can't hear another conversation.

chill.title: Slow Morning at Postman's Park
chill.description: Find the tiny City garden with a wall of hand-painted tiles remembering ordinary people who died saving others.
chill.bonus: Read every tile before you leave.

chill.title: Lost Afternoon at Tate Modern
chill.description: Lose an afternoon inside Tate Modern's cavernous Turbine Hall and its ever-changing gallery walls.
chill.bonus: Find one piece of art you genuinely dislike and explain why.

chill.title: Picnic by the Serpentine
chill.description: Spread a blanket by the Serpentine and watch the swans drift while Hyde Park hums quietly around you.
chill.bonus: Leave your phone in your bag for the whole picnic.

chill.title: Sunday Morning at Columbia Road Flower Market
chill.description: Weave through stalls overflowing with tulips and dahlias at London's most fragrant Sunday market.
chill.bonus: Buy one flower for no reason at all.

culture.title: A Play at the Old Vic
culture.description: Catch a two-hour production in a 200-year-old room where the seats are close enough to hear the actors breathe.
culture.bonus: Book without reading a single review first.

culture.title: Stand-Up at the Top Secret Comedy Club
culture.description: Duck into a Covent Garden basement where touring headliners try out material on eighty people.

culture.title: The Cast Courts at the V&A
culture.description: Stand under a full-size plaster Trajan's Column, sawn in half to fit the room, in the strangest gallery in London.
culture.bonus: Sketch one object badly before you leave.

culture.title: The Crowded Rooms of Sir John Soane's Museum
culture.description: Squeeze through an architect's house stuffed floor-to-ceiling with sarcophagi, casts and paintings that swing off the walls on hinges.
culture.bonus: Find the sarcophagus in the basement before you look it up.

culture.title: Late Friday at the British Museum
culture.description: Wander the Great Court after dark when the day crowds have gone and the galleries turn quiet and golden.
culture.bonus: Pick one object and read every word of its label.

culture.title: Matchday on the Thames at Craven Cottage
culture.description: Take in a Premier League afternoon at the prettiest ground in the league, with the river running behind the Putney End.
culture.bonus: Learn one terrace chant before kickoff and actually sing it.

culture.title: Groundling Ticket at Shakespeare's Globe
culture.description: Stand in the yard for a fiver and watch the play the way the Elizabethans did — on your feet, open to the sky.
culture.bonus: Stay standing the whole show. No leaning.

culture.title: Underground at the Churchill War Rooms
culture.description: Drop into the sealed bunker where the war was run, with the map pins still stuck exactly where they were left in 1945.
culture.bonus: Stand in the Map Room for a full minute without talking.

adventure.title: Walk the Thames Path from Hammersmith to Putney
adventure.description: Trace the rowing stretch of the river past boathouses and riverside pubs on the quietest good walk in west London.
adventure.bonus: Finish with a pint at the first riverside pub you pass.

adventure.title: Open-Water Swim at West Reservoir Centre
adventure.description: Swim a marked loop in a proper reservoir in the middle of Stoke Newington, wetsuit optional.
adventure.bonus: Swim the long loop instead of the short one.

adventure.title: Ride the Slide at the ArcelorMittal Orbit
adventure.description: Drop 178 metres down the world's longest tunnel slide, wrapped around Stratford's red steel sculpture.
adventure.bonus: Keep your eyes open the whole way down.

adventure.title: Wakeboard at Wake Up Docklands
adventure.description: Get pulled across the Royal Victoria Dock on a cable tow with the Canary Wharf towers as your backdrop.
adventure.bonus: Stay up for one full lap without falling.

adventure.title: Cycle the Regent's Canal to Camden
adventure.description: Follow the towpath past narrowboats, locks and graffiti walls from Little Venice all the way into Camden Lock.
adventure.bonus: Stop at every lock and watch one boat go through.

adventure.title: Climb the 311 Steps of the Monument
adventure.description: Spiral up a stone column built to mark the Great Fire and pop out onto a caged balcony over the City.
adventure.bonus: Climb the whole thing without stopping.

adventure.title: Deer-Spotting Loop Through Richmond Park
adventure.description: Run or walk the park's outer path and come face to face with red deer grazing a few metres off the trail.
adventure.bonus: Get a photo of a stag — from a respectful distance.

adventure.title: Swim the Hampstead Heath Mixed Pond
adventure.description: Change in a wooden hut and drop off the ladder into cold brown water with ducks for company.
adventure.bonus: Go all the way under on the first attempt.

adventure.title: Bouldering Session at The Castle
adventure.description: Chalk up and work your way through the colorful bouldering walls at The Castle Climbing Centre.
adventure.bonus: Attempt a route two grades above your comfort level.

adventure.title: Climb Up at The O2
adventure.description: Strap in and climb up and over the O2's iconic canopy for a 360° sunset view across London.
adventure.bonus: Don't check your phone until you're back on the ground.

adventure.title: Sunrise Run Along the South Bank
adventure.description: Lace up for a sunrise run along the South Bank as the city wakes up around St Paul's and the Globe.
adventure.bonus: Watch the sunrise fully before checking your phone.

adventure.title: Go Ape Battersea Park Treetop Course
adventure.description: Swing, zip, and climb your way through the treetops of Battersea Park on a high-ropes course built for grown-up kids.
adventure.bonus: Complete the highest zip line with your eyes open the whole way.

adventure.title: Kayak Little Venice's Canals
adventure.description: Glide a kayak past houseboats and willow trees through the quiet backwaters of Little Venice.
adventure.bonus: Paddle past at least three houseboats and wave at the owners.

adventure.title: Thames RIB Speedboat Experience
adventure.description: Blast down the Thames at 30mph on a high-speed RIB, dodging spray and passing Tower Bridge in a blur.
adventure.bonus: Sit in the front row and get soaked on purpose.

social.title: Bowling and Beers at All Star Lanes
social.description: Take a lane in the Brick Lane basement with retro pins, booth seating and a proper cocktail list.
social.bonus: Bowl one frame with your wrong hand.

social.title: All Night at Fabric
social.description: Commit to Farringdon's concrete cathedral of a club and the bodysonic floor that vibrates through your feet until dawn.

social.title: Karaoke Booth at Karaoke Box Soho
social.description: Lock yourselves in a private room with a screen, a tambourine and no audience but each other.
social.bonus: Sing something outside your range on purpose.

social.title: Late Show at Ronnie Scott's
social.description: Take the 11pm slot in Soho's basement jazz institution, where the room goes quiet the moment the horn starts.
social.bonus: Stay for the last song even if it's late.

social.title: Rooftop Drinks at Netil360
social.description: Climb to a scruffy, brilliant London Fields rooftop for cheap drinks and a full sweep of the eastern skyline.
social.bonus: Stay for the exact moment the lights come on across the city.

social.title: Live Gig at the Windmill Brixton
social.description: See a band two years before everyone else does, in a scruffy pub venue with a dog that wanders the stage.
social.bonus: Buy the support act's record at the merch table.

social.title: Ping Pong and Cocktails at Bounce
social.description: Play doubles on a table in the Old Street basement where the game was reportedly patented, drink in hand.

social.title: Sunday Session at The Prince of Wales, Brixton
social.description: Spend a long afternoon on a Brixton rooftop with DJs, a crowd and no plan to be anywhere else.
social.bonus: Talk to someone you didn't arrive with.

social.title: West End Night at the Lyceum Theatre
social.description: Dress up and catch a West End production at the historic Lyceum Theatre, velvet seats and all.
social.bonus: Dress up a little more than you think you need to.

social.title: Pub Quiz Night at The Churchill Arms
social.description: Grab a pint at The Churchill Arms and battle it out at one of London's best-loved pub quizzes.
social.bonus: Join a table of strangers for the next round.

social.title: Free Skyline Cocktails at Sky Garden
social.description: Ride the lift 35 floors up to Sky Garden for skyline views and cocktails without paying an entry fee.
social.bonus: Toast to something good that happened this month.

social.title: Shoreditch Pub Crawl
social.description: Start at The Old Blue Last and let a proper Shoreditch pub crawl carry you through the night.
social.bonus: Talk to someone at the bar you don't know.

8ball.title: Sunset Ride on the London Cable Car
8ball.description: Float across the Thames in a glass gondola on the London Cable Car, no particular reason required.
8ball.bonus: Sit on the side facing away from the skyline and guess what's out the other window.

8ball.title: Caricature Portrait in Covent Garden
8ball.description: Sit for a quick caricature portrait from a street artist in Covent Garden Piazza.
8ball.bonus: Ask the artist to exaggerate your worst feature.
